summary: Villenave-d'Ornon is a commune of Bordeaux Métropole where the town's own on-street parking rules found are simple (alternate-side parking by fortnight, municipal police enforcement), and no municipal paid-parking or blue-zone scheme appears on its official site. The main organised parking offer is the metropolitan park-and-ride Villenave Pyrénées at the end of tram line C (753 spaces, 20 with EV charging), run under TBM fares: included with a TBM subscription, otherwise a reduced ticket of 3.50 euros. The metropolitan low-emission zone covers the area inside the ring road since January 2025 and bars only unclassified vehicles; Villenave Pyrénées is not among the 11 park-and-rides listed for them. Local projects add or reorganise street parking (rue René Voisin, rue Jean-Pagès, place du marché de Chambéry), and the rail works south of Bordeaux (to 2032) include a multimodal hub at the Villenave-d'Ornon station. The metropolis charges 0.38 euro per kWh at its public EV stations since January 2025.

items.text: TBM's park-and-ride list (page read on 21 October 2026) shows Pyrénées, avenue des Pyrénées, Villenave-d'Ornon, under the tram C park-and-rides: 753 spaces, 20 disabled spaces, 20 with EV charging points, 8 secure bicycle spaces, maximum height 1.90 m, open to all.
items.source_title: Opening times, maps and list of Parcs-Relais (TBM)

items.text: On TBM's day-parking page (read on 21 October 2026), same-day park-and-ride parking is included in a TBM subscription; other users buy a park-and-ride ticket at 4.50 euros, or 3.50 euros at the reduced rate, which gives 7 round trips for 1 to 7 people. Villenave-Pyrénées is on the list of 11 reduced-price park-and-rides, and an unvalidated ticket does not open the exit.

TBM's park-and-ride list page (read on 21 October 2026) says the sites are open when trams run (5am to 1am Mon-Wed, Sun and holidays; to 2am Thu-Sat) and parking outside those hours risks a 15 euro fine per day. The day-parking page of the same site (also read on 21 October 2026) gives different closing times and a 25 euro flat fine, so the figures are inconsistent between TBM pages.
items.source_title: Opening times, maps and list of Parcs-Relais (TBM)

items.text: Villenave Pyrénées is one of 11 of the 28 metropolitan park-and-rides that sell short-stay tickets (page read on 21 October 2026): 12 euros for 2 days/1 night, 15 euros for 3 days, 20 euros for 4 days and 25 euros for 5 days, each with a round trip on the TBM network.

TBM's overnight-near-home offer (300 euros a year, or 25 euros a month by direct debit, for residents within 500 m) covers six park-and-rides; Villenave Pyrénées is not among them (page read on 21 October 2026).

Bordeaux Métropole's low-emission zone has applied inside the ring road (rocade excluded) since 1 January 2025, day and night; the page was updated on 13 January 2026. Only unclassified vehicles (no Crit'Air sticker, such as petrol or diesel cars registered before 1 January 1997) are barred, but every vehicle needs a sticker, and a pass allows unclassified vehicles in for up to 24 days a year.
items.source_title: ZFE (Zone à Faibles Émissions) : ce qu'il faut savoir (Se Déplacer Bordeaux Métropole)

items.text: The same metropolitan page lists 11 intra-rocade park-and-rides reachable by unclassified vehicles (Brandeburg, 40 Journaux, Gare de Bruges, Hippodrome, Les Pins, Bougnard, Unitec, Arena, Dravemont, Buttinière, Lauriers). Villenave Pyrénées is not on the list; the page does not say whether it lies inside the zone.
items.source_title: ZFE (Zone à Faibles Émissions) : ce qu'il faut savoir (Se Déplacer Bordeaux Métropole)

items.text: The metropolitan public charging network has charged 0.38 euro per kWh since 6 January 2025, plus 4 euros an hour if a slow-charge session exceeds 4 hours (waived 11pm-8am on AC), capped at 48 euros beyond 14 hours. The page, read on 21 October 2026, is metropolis-wide and does not list Villenave-d'Ornon stations.
items.source_title: Recharger mon véhicule électrique (Se Déplacer Bordeaux Métropole)

items.text: The same page says use of the metropolitan public charging network rose 54% in the first quarter of 2025 versus the first quarter of 2024, and 61,367 charges were made in 2024. It also says the 2022 charging plan foresees over 90 additional street stations over three years (metropolis-wide figures).
items.source_title: Recharger mon véhicule électrique (Se Déplacer Bordeaux Métropole)

items.text: The town's civility page (read on 21 October 2026) says on-street parking in Villenave-d'Ornon is mostly alternate-side: odd house numbers from the 1st to the 15th of the month, even numbers from the 16th to month end; some streets have fixed one-sided parking marked by signs.
The town's municipal police page (read on 21 October 2026) lists obstructive parking (stationnement gênant) among the offences its officers record; it describes no paid-parking or blue-zone scheme.

Published on 10 June 2026: rue René Voisin is to be redeveloped after resident consultation, creating 28 marked parking spaces on the odd-number side, to ease bus movements and make vehicle exits safer. The page gives no start date.
items.source_title: Aménagement stationnement rue René Voisin (Ville de Villenave d'Ornon)

items.text: Rue Jean-Pagès (Pont de la Maye) is being rebuilt from 6 January 2026 to 26 November 2027 (page updated 8 October 2026): one-way traffic, parking banned beside active works, and the project includes new parking for cars and heavy goods vehicles.
items.source_title: Infos travaux réaménagement Jean-Pagès (Ville de Villenave d'Ornon)

items.text: The town's mobility page (read on 21 October 2026) counts 22 km of cycle paths and four Vélo by TBM stations in Villenave-d'Ornon, and says a mobile bike shop is based at the P+R Villenave Pyrénées. It notes that the TBM network was reorganised in September 2023.
items.source_title: Déplacements et mobilité écoresponsable (Ville de Villenave d'Ornon)

items.text: From 6 December 2025 the TBM tram network was reorganised: line C now runs between Parc des Expositions - Stade Atlantique and Villenave Pyrénées (the Blanquefort branch passed to new line E), with a tram every 10 minutes in the daytime. The town's page was updated on 23 January 2026.
items.source_title: Le réseau TBM évolue (Ville de Villenave d'Ornon)

items.text: At a site visit on 9 June 2026, Bordeaux Métropole said works on the rail upgrades south of Bordeaux (third track Bègles to Saint-Médard-d'Eyrans, 12 km, with crossing points at four stations including Villenave-d'Ornon) began in 2025. The release says four multimodal interchange hubs are planned, including one at Villenave-d'Ornon, with service entry planned for 2032; it gives no figures for station parking.
items.source_title: AFSB : les travaux se poursuivent (Bordeaux Métropole press release, 9 June 2026)

items.text: The regional transport page (undated, read on 21 October 2026) schedules the Villenave-d'Ornon station works in 2025, with train services at the station interrupted while the work is carried out, and lists a 10-minute longer journey time on TER line 44 Bordeaux - Agen. It says the programme will make the stations accessible and connect them to other modes through multimodal hubs.
items.source_title: Travaux : les aménagements ferroviaires au sud de Bordeaux (Nouvelle-Aquitaine transports)

items.text: The renovated place du marché in the Chambéry district (route de Léognan), a square the town's May 2025 notice calls a useful parking space outside market day, was due to be inaugurated on 25 March 2026 after works begun in May 2025. It keeps 18 marked parking spaces.
items.source_title: La nouvelle place du marché de Chambéry inaugurée (Ville de Villenave d'Ornon press release, 20 March 2026)
